description: This file defines a PHP trait named SocialMediaAuthenticationServiceTrait in the namespace OrangeHRM\OpenidAuthentication\Traits\Service. The trait includes a method to access the SocialMediaAuthenticationService from a service container, facilitating dependency injection for social media authentication functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSocialMediaAuthenticationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of SocialMediaAuthenticationService by retrieving it from the service container.
